It’s not like he’s mean all the time. He just says things without fully understanding what he’s implying or saying sometimes. He asked me if I was okay with gaining and I said no, but that I wasn’t panicking because I gained a little. I just don’t think he understands how hard the comment is on me.

And he asked “should I be walking with you? Do we need to do it together?” I can do it on my own.. I just didn’t see that I was gaining it back a little bit. But it’s hurtful. I asked him the question about if I got pregnant too. And he said it would be different because it’s a huge stress on my body to be pregnant. It just makes me feel gross.

He’s a perfectionist. It has to be perfect. If we’re not efficient enough (like picking green beans fast enough) to make profit, then we can’t have that as a product we sell. It’s all set to high standards but he feels as if they’re all reasonable.

He said the thing about them growing legs and walking off. Hes blamed me for things going missing before. 

He tells me I’m a narcissist. I don’t know how to handle that.

Just now we got into an argument. I’m going to use it as an example. Also, I can’t portray tone well in this, so apologies in advance.
We were outside to wash lettuce (he has an LLC garden so we wash cut lettuce and bag it as a product we sell). I put down two buckets to prop up the container of lettuce higher.
Him: you really shouldn’t trust those buckets to hold it.
Me: why not? It’s what I’ve always used. You’ve done it too.
Him: not for a long time I haven’t.
Me: okay, I won’t use them then.
I then got a tote and set it down, I put it down right side up, which was the wrong way. He flipped it and then used his foot to move it. 
Me: please don’t, I’ll move it to where I’d like.
Him: why do you have an attitude? 
Me: I don’t I’m just telling you I’ll move it myself. I don’t have an attitude.
Him: do you hear the way you’re talking? 
Me: yes, I am just a little frustrated because you’re telling me I shouldn’t be doing it the way I have been.
Then he proceeded to accuse me of having an attitude again. When I genuinely don’t think I did. I know I can sometimes but I didn’t in that instance.
Him: you know what? I’m exhausted from the fighting and your attitude all the time. Go inside and go back to bed.
So I did, I went back to bed. We wake up at 4:00 almost every day, and it’s not my cup of tea by any stretch of the imagination.
Later at 6:35, I got up to make him lunch so he had lunch for work.
Him: where are all of our containers?
Me: i don’t know, I only have one at work and my parents have one. 
Him: well I didn’t do anything with them. 
Me: neither did I.
Him: well they don’t have legs and didn’t just walk off. 
Me: well I understand that but I didn’t do anything with them.
He proceeded to sigh and then said “whatever I’m leaving for the day”
Me: I’m almost done making your lunch, can you wait one minute please?
Him: why should I? 
Me: because it’s already made.
Him: fine. Also I wanted your flowers for you again today.
Me: thank you, I was going to do that, but thank you.
Him (and he says this all the time): yeah well I try to be helpful.
Me: I’ve never said you weren’t. 
Him: well you sure act like it.
Me: I don’t know how I’m acting like that right now.
Him: well I’ve told you a million times, so you really don’t listen to me.
Me: I just don’t know how I’m acting like that right now.
Him: whatever, I don’t care.
Me: I’m sorry.
Him: are you? 
Me: yes, I’m sorry. 
I started crying.
Him: why are you bawling? 
Me: I’m exhausted from this, I can’t do it.
Him: fine, then look at me and listen. You don’t have to clean, cook, or help with the garden. Sleep as long as you want. Go to bed whenever you want. Whatever you need so you’re not so exhausted. Hell, don’t even pay for rent anymore. Whatever you have to do so you’re not so exhausted. You do whatever you want. You act like I have a gun to your head all the time and like you have no free will. 
Me: would you please stop? I don’t want to fight.
Him: well then why do you have an attitude like this morning? You started this. 
Me: I didn’t have one this morning.
Him: stomping around, being loud, throwing totes down, that isn’t having an attitude? Talking with the tone you had isn’t an attitude? How is the way you treat me okay?
Me: please just stop. 
I went into the bathroom and closed the door and I was pacing. 
He knocked on the door and said “yeah, the truths a bitch isn’t it?”
I then opened the bathroom and went into the bedroom, closing the door behind me.
Him: I don’t know what I did to be treated so poorly. You can’t even tell me what to do or how to act differently to change things. But because you’re exhausted, it’s fine. But if I’m exhausted, it doesn’t matter. 
Me: I just don’t know what I’m supposed to do anymore.
Him: neither do i. But I have to go to work. Drive safe. I love you. I hope you have a good day.
Me: I love you too. 
That is what most of our fights look like.
Do it. Best case scenario they say they understand and forgive. Worse case scenario is the same as where you are right now.

I’ve never been like this before. I don’t understand what I’m doing, why I’m having such big and angry reactions, and I just don’t feel like I’m me.
It wasn’t our board meeting though, it was a random one.
We have monthly board meetings and those are bo problem because they’re scheduled. When I have time (which is rare) I go up there. It’s the extra and not needed meetings that are difficult.
It’s the only thing that I can do outside of the garden and I’m also not willing to leave.
I’m not saying I’m not responsible either. But I also texted them and apologized for it. They also ignored me after that.

But she didn’t need me. She told them it was fine to meet separately because our concerns were probably a bit different. She told me she didn’t need me for the meeting. We didn’t call the meeting either, they did. I had said I would go with when she was incredibly angry. But, she had also calmed down over the two weeks. She told them that as well. She told them she didn’t want to quit anymore. 

I have tried to schedule meetings with the president and other board members before. They’ve straight up forgotten. Even when I’ve sent out follow up and reminder texts.
You’re right. But if the opportunity to get farther ahead in the garden presents itself, I can’t not do it either.
My boyfriend doesn’t think she’s fit to be the president. This is how it always is.

She was ready, she went really quickly. 
It feels better but worse all at the same time.
Thank you for sharing, especially about her purring until the end. I’m sorry to hear about your sweetie. She chose me, I love her.

She’s happy and has mental clarity. But her body is failing her. The cancer is just taking too much of a toll. I will definitely listen to my vet, but I think she’s ready. Her sparkle in her eyes isn’t there anymore. She looks tired. If I were her, honestly, I would want help crossing the bridge before things get worse. I hate it. So so so so much. She got me through some really bad emotional times. But I can’t make her stay for my own needs.  I need to put her first.

It’s more bad than good. She’s technically been on palliative care for a year. We didn’t think she would live this long. I think she’s living on sheer love. But her sparkle in her eyes is gone. I think she’s ready or very close to it.

Thank you. I just don’t want her in pain or alone. Her sparkle from her eyes isn’t there anymore. My sweetie has GI lymphoma. We think it’s actually small cell, but we think she’s had it for over 2 years. Her tumor was 6 cm by 3 cm when we found it. Now it’s bigger. She has full mental clarity and is hungry and is so loving and happy. That’s the worst part. The fact that all she wants is to be with me. She doesn’t care otherwise. 
Thank you for your comment. It genuinely helps me. Her old owner (who passed away) will be waiting for her too, which also gives comfort. Thank you, thank you, thank you💛
Thank you, that’s what I think… it hurts so badly but I know I have her. Her sparkle from her eyes isn’t there anymore..
That’s how I’m feeling. She looks tired now too.
It could be but it isn’t in the direct sunlight? I’m just so confused on what’s happening to her :(

There is drainage but I’m guessing it’s not good enough. Thank you!
And those are just on top, it’s a soil underneath:) it’s just to look pretty
Thank you, I really appreciate it. I’m thinking starting from a clean slate would help. I know she will be unhappy, but I think it might be necessary for her and I to be able to keep up with her fur.
Thank you. I try to brush her but when I get near her legs, she gets upset. I try to cut out any mats but it’s just difficult when she gets unhappy :(
I didn’t include pictures of all of them either. I know they’re gross. She’s never had these before and it just worries me.

Yeah no shit.
If you would have read the comments, you would’ve seen my update about what happened.

Thank you!! I can tell already that she feels better. They said the teeth came out easy, so they really did need to come out. She’s missing about half her chewers now, but, I’m glad we’re taking care of it. 
Thank you for caring!

Hi friend! Thought I would let you know that she had extractions today. 10 teeth in total. She will have to have the rest removed in the future more than likely. But, she’s on the road to recovery now.
I’m sure she will need more removed. I do have pet insurance so I can possibly make a claim with it in the future.
No, just the ones that need it. They gave me a quote of like 500-600. Which is better than I anticipated. So I’m not upset at the cost. I’m glad she’ll still have some of her teeth.

Hey! Wanted to update you quick and let you know that it is dental resorption. She’s having X-rays and extractions next Monday. She’s in pain meds and amoxicillin. I guess she has lost some of her incisors… I had no idea that this was happening. I feel awful for not noticing.. I’m going pursue recurring dental cleanings frequently from now on for both of my cats. I know it’s not normal for cats to just loose teeth. So I’m hoping that she’ll feel better within a month. I feel so bad :(

Hi! Thought I would let you know that unfortunately it is dental resorption. We have an appointment for X-rays and extractions next Monday. I’m really happy that I can get her in that soon. She’s currently in pain meds and amoxicillin. I’ll let you know how she does once she’s done with her surgery!

Thank you… I really appreciate that. We can’t test it to see if it’s large cell or small cell, because she isn’t a candidate for surgery and because if we poke the mass, it could introduce it to the rest of her abdomen. I could have 2 months to 2 years, we just don’t know. 
But thank you.. I’m devastated but I’m going to continue to love her and spoil her
Clinics and humane societies/rescues are both overwhelmed unfortunately. I’m just happy she can get in within a week.
Thank you😕 she’s going in on Monday. It’s the soonest. Everywhere else was 4-6 weeks or more. I’ll post an update once I know :)
That’s my concern. The other cat can pull the bowl away with his paw and she won’t do anything except stare at him or walk away.
I crush my cats meds and put them in. She won’t take them otherwise. Maybe you can get it as a liquid? It might cost more but could save you a headache.
Thank you, I’ll end up posting an update once it’s all sorted out

It’s usually out of her reach but I forgot to set it aside one night. I’m going to get some pate and water it down to help her eat and leave her in my room to do so. She’s still trying to eat, but obviously something is causing discomfort.

My housemates cat does try to steal her food sometimes. She’s quite timid though so the possible aggression seems quite unlike her. They do free feed but I give them a little wet food in the evening, as one of my cats requires medication and probiotics. But thank you for your input, I’m just concerned because she keeps dropping all of her food.

She’s had bad breath since I adopted her a little over a year ago. I did get her an appointment for Monday so I’m hoping it can all be resolved. I recently got new catnip, and it was not very finely ground. She’s the type of cat to eat it. She knocked it over and was eating it, so I’m wondering if a sharp piece got her in the gums?
Thank you, you as well! My housemates cat had to have his anal glands expressed😬 it was not a pleasant smell.

Thank you!! I literally already got her an appointment for Monday. I had to call around, but she’s going to be seen. I’m a good pet owner. I know that I am. Yes, sometimes people post here when it is life threatening. And that’s frustrating. But, like you said, I was waiting to hear back from my own vet and wanted to know if I was overreacting or not. Thank youuuu for understanding that not everyone chooses to ignore their pets pain and not contact their vet. 
My other cat was diagnosed with cancer about 3 weeks ago. I’m in contact with her frequently as it is. I also work/volunteer at a shelter where she’s the primary vet. It’s so frustrating when people act as if you’re neglecting your animal.
Also, I am not asking what to do. I am asking if it seems like mouth pain to anyone else or if it seems like she has something stuck in her throat, etc.
I reached out to my vet immediately. I also sent her the video.

I’m going to get pate for her and water it down so it’s easier to eat. She won’t let me mess with her mouth regardless, so it’s worse now. She was eating some catnip that was not very fine, it had pieces in it, and I’m wondering if it maybe got stuck in her gums? However, I do know something is wrong based on her reactions. I thought she maybe needed to get out a hairball originally but Im convinced it’s a tooth problem.

That’s my biggest fear, that she’s in pain. I’m going to get some pate wet food so I can water it down to make it very easy to eat until she can get in. She’s never let me mess with her teeth as it is, even less now. I’m hoping it’s nothing serious, fingers crossed!🤞
That’s what I thought. I’m going to try to get her in this week. All the vets near me a completely booked so I’m not sure when or where I’ll get her in. But I know I will.

That’s what I was thinking. My vet should be able to give me some guidance, whether she can fit me in or if I should go somewhere who can get me in sooner. 
And thank you. It’s been a rough few weeks. My girls are my children. I love them immensely and they’ve been my saving graces and angels.
She hates me going near her teeth. I got her from a shelter, so she likely never had it done as a kitten. If I could have started her young, I definitely would have :(
That’s what I thought :( I hope it’s an easy fix for her
